name: guard-pack
description: Six guards in one Node process for Codex CLI: blocks dangerous shell commands, secret reads and writes, disabled or deleted tests, git pushes to main, guardrail config tampering and case-collision deletes. Checks every shell command and every apply_patch edit. Guards set to ask are sent as blocks, because Codex hooks cannot ask. The subagent spawn cap is Claude Code only for now.

interface.shortDescription: Blocks dangerous commands, secret access and test tampering before they run
